name: Draft replies to new YouTube comments with Gemini and review them in Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Draft replies to new YouTube comments with Gemini and review them in Google Sheets

Reply to more of your YouTube comments in less time. Every six hours this workflow finds new, unanswered comments on your latest videos, sorts them (question, praise, criticism, collaboration, spam) and has Google Gemini draft a reply in your channel's voice. Everything lands in a Google Sheet with a direct link to the comment, so you can copy, tweak and post the good ones in seconds. Nothing is posted automatically.

### How it works
1. **Every 6 hours** starts the run. Your five newest uploads come from the channel's free RSS feed (no API quota).
2. **Get comment threads** calls the official YouTube Data API for each video.
3. **Pick new unanswered comments** keeps recent top-level comments with no reply that aren't yours.
4. **Skip comments already drafted** removes anything seen in earlier runs.
5. **Draft reply with AI** returns category, priority and a reply; spam and emoji-only comments are dropped.
6. Drafts are appended to Google Sheets, highest priority first.

### Setup
1. Add a **YouTube OAuth2** credential (YouTube Data API v3 enabled) and a free **Google Gemini (PaLM) API** credential.
2. Put your channel ID (starts with `UC`) and voice in **Set channel and settings**.
3. Create a sheet with a `Comments` tab and header row: `drafted_at, priority, category, video_title, author, comment, reply_draft, summary, link, comment_id, status`. Put the Sheet ID in **Set channel and settings**.
4. Activate.

### Customization
- Change `lookback_hours` or the schedule.

Failure alerts: fill in the alert node in **Alert on errors** and choose this workflow under **Settings > Error workflow**.

assignments.name: channel_voice
assignments.value: Friendly, practical and a bit nerdy. Uses first names, short sentences, no corporate speak.

parameters.jsCode:
// The 5 newest uploads are where almost all new comments land
return $input.all().slice(0, 5).map(i => ({ json: { video_id: String(i.json.id || '').replace('yt:video:', ''), title: i.json.title } }));

parameters.text:
=You help a YouTube creator reply to comments on their videos.

Channel voice: {{ $('Set channel and settings').first().json.channel_voice }}
Video title: {{ $json.video_title }}
Comment by {{ $json.author }}:
"{{ $json.text }}"

Rules:
- category: question, praise, feedback, criticism, collaboration, spam or other.
- needs_reply: false for spam, emoji-only, or comments that need no answer.
- priority: high for questions, collaboration or business enquiries and constructive criticism; normal for praise and feedback; low otherwise.
- reply: under 60 words in the channel's voice, specific to the comment, friendly, no hashtags, no links unless the comment asks for a resource (then say "linked in the description"). Never promise things the creator has not said. Empty string if needs_reply is false.
- Never state facts (version numbers, prices, dates, specs, URLs) that are not in the video title, the comment or the facts given above. If the answer needs a fact you do not have, thank them and say the creator will follow up or point them to the description.
- summary: under 10 words.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "category": "question",
  "priority": "high",
  "needs_reply": true,
  "reply": "Great question! The template is linked in the description; start with step 2 if you already have n8n.",
  "summary": "Asks where to find the template"
}

## Alert on errors
Runs as its own execution when any node fails. Put your e-mail address in the alert node, then in **Workflow settings > Error workflow** pick this workflow.
